observed: Desktop and phone renders: h1 'Su fiscalidad en orden, explicada sin rodeos.' plus lead naming the audience (autonomos, pequenas sociedades) and the promise (know scope and cost before starting). One primary button 'Escribir una consulta' in the first viewport.

One .btn on the page (mailto, 48px high, full width at <=600px). The contact email is a secondary text link to the same target. The note under the button says 'No pedimos datos hasta que usted decide seguir'.
check_contrast, light mode: ink/bg 14.42, muted/bg 5.90, muted/surface 6.21, accent/bg 7.27, on-accent/accent 7.65, muted/line 4.77. All >= 4.5:1.

styles.css line 22: :focus-visible 3px outline in the accent colour, offset 3px. The accent is 7.27:1 on the light background and 10.12:1 on the dark one. A skip link exists and shows on focus. Not driven in a browser.
Phone render 390px: body 16px, one column, no horizontal scroll visible, nav links and footer links min-height 44px, button 48px high and 100% wide. Email link has overflow-wrap:anywhere.

One dominant h1 (48px). Type levels are h1 48, h2 32, h3 20, with serif plus Inter as the only 2 typefaces. Spacing uses a 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64/96 token scale. One accent colour. Taste lint: 27 checks, 1 fail, blocking=none.

No testimonials, logos, awards or invented credentials. Scope is explicit, with a 'Para quien es / No es para usted si' section naming exclusions. Fees say 'presupuesto cerrado' and no invented prices. The footer, privacy and terms all disclose the business is fictional.

privacy.html and terms.html exist, are linked from the footer, and the renders are filled and consistent. Privacy states no forms, cookies or analytics and discloses the Google Fonts request. Terms say the site gives no advice and no offer. I did not run the legal_surface check.
The 'Volver al inicio' link sits directly under the last paragraph, with zero gap, on privacy.html and terms.html, desktop and phone. There is no .doc p+p margin and no spacing token between them.
recommendation: Add .doc p+p{margin-top:var(--s4)} or put margin-top:var(--s5) on the back link.

observed: TASTE-GOOGLE-FONTS-LINK (MINOR) on index.html. The BRIEF explicitly allows Google Fonts, and privacy.html discloses the request.
recommendation: Self-host the fonts if wanted. The BRIEF permits the current setup, so this is a non-blocking lint.
